title: Homelab Command Center
description: Master dashboard: every signal from the homelab on one screen. Drill into the linked dashboards for detail.

options.content:
Homelab Command Center
odin · thor · loki — Nomad + Consul, TrueNAS storage, Traefik ingress, Authentik SSO
NodesNomadWorkloadsTraefikPowerAuthentikSecurityLogsHost logsMonitoringAlerts

panels.title: Cluster health
panels.description: Healthy when all node exporters and Nomad agents are up and no scrape target is down.

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description: node-exporter targets answering, out of 3.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: Nomad jobs in the running state (reported by the leader).

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Prometheus scrape targets that are not answering.

panels.title: Security events 24h
panels.description: Falco rule matches across all nodes in the last 24 hours. Open Security for the breakdown.

panels.title: Backups
panels.description: Backup jobs that ran this week but not in the last 26 hours (same check as the backup-stale alert).

targets.expr: count(count by (parent_id) (count_over_time(nomad_client_allocs_memory_rss{parent_id=~".+-backup"}[7d])) unless count by (parent_id) (count_over_time(nomad_client_allocs_memory_rss{parent_id=~".+-backup"}[26h])) and on (parent_id) label_replace(max by (exported_job) (nomad_nomad_job_summary_running), "parent_id", "$1", "exported_job", "(.+)")) or vector(0)

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Estimated wall power: RAPL CPU + DRAM, plus 12 W per node and 35 W for the NAS.

panels.title: NAS used
panels.description: TrueNAS /storage NFS share.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: All Traefik services.

panels.title: Cert expiry
panels.description: Soonest TLS certificate expiry. Let's Encrypt renews at 30 days.

panels.title: SSO outposts
panels.description: Authentik outposts connected. 0 breaks forward-auth.

panels.title: OOM kills 24h
panels.description: Kernel OOM kills across all nodes in the last 24h.

panels.title: Restarts 24h
panels.description: Nomad task restarts in the last 24h.

panels.title: Error log lines 1h
panels.description: Log lines matching error, fatal, panic, oom or failed in the last hour.

panels.title: Min uptime
panels.description: Most recently rebooted node.

panels.title: Homelab map
panels.description: Live state of the three Nomad nodes, ingress and the NAS. Card borders turn red when a node is down.

text.fixed: keepalived VIP, TLS via Let's Encrypt
NFS /storage for every job and backup

panels.title: Firing and pending alerts
panels.description: Firing and pending Grafana alerts, newest first.

panels.title: Load (5m) per core
panels.description: Above 100% means more runnable work than cores.

panels.title: Closest to memory_max
panels.description: RSS as a share of each task's hard memory limit.

panels.title: Memory reserved vs used per node
panels.description: Solid: RSS in use. Dashed: memory reserved by allocations.

panels.title: Periodic runs (backups, scans)
panels.description: Bars show when each periodic job was running.

panels.title: Pressure stall (memory / io)
panels.description: Share of time tasks were stalled waiting on memory or disk. Rising memory stall precedes OOM kills.
